_comment: Seed fixture for the reproduction-steps-htmx widget-type bead.
Created for ka-0000007835 (Phase 4 free-htmx port — fourth port after
activity-log-htmx, MR !2334 / ka-0000004584; related-tickets-htmx,
MR !2346 / ka-0000005540; and header-incident-summary-htmx, MR !2347 /
ka-0000005304). Strategy A — port-then-soak: lives alongside the Go-
coded `reproduction-steps` slug rather than replacing it.
Authoring path:
kd create 'Free-htmx widget: reproduction-steps-htmx' \
--type=widget-type \
-F gardenio/controller/cmd/beads-viewer/fixtures/reproduction-steps-htmx.json
Pre-write hooks (kbeads/internal/server/widget_validation.go) parse
template_source under html/template and reject malformed inputs at
createBead/updateBead time, so a bad fixture surfaces immediately.
Schema validation runs against widget-instance writes per the same
pre-write hook; the schema below is the wire contract.
The wire contract mirrors the Go-coded `reproduction-steps` renderer at
widgets_phase4.go::renderReproductionSteps — flat steps[] of strings.
The htmx template intentionally does NOT render markdown (the Go path
uses goldmark via widgetRenderCtx.md, which has no template-only
equivalent); the `markdown` field is therefore a parity gap documented
in the port doc and in TestReproductionStepsParity. Producers cutting
a reproduction-steps-htmx widget-instance should emit steps[].

fields.template_source:
{{- $steps := index .Payload "steps" -}} {{if $steps}}
    {{range $steps}}
  1. {{.}}
    2. {{end}}
{{else}}

No reproduction steps recorded.

{{end}}

steps: Click Upload — observe the spinner hang
